construction: always-on funding-carry sleeve, short 1x perp + long 1x spot, equal notional both legs, 50/50 BTC/ETH; margin = 1/3 of perp notional (realized leverage <= 3x by construction)

registered_gate.note: stressed = after execution-realism cost pass C2 haircuts

gate_inputs.detail: worst-90d raw sleeve loss 1.82% < 5% floor even at 100% notional; passes at both 20% and 50% intended allocation with wide margin.

pass1_timing.note: one-bar funding lag leaves SR essentially intact; no material funding look-ahead.

pass2_costs.note: gate-relevant stress bound. See rebalance-convention caveat: stressed carry realistically a RANGE [3.75, ~5.9].

caveats: Rebalance-convention range: the stressed SR of 3.75 uses the conservative -perp_ret drift convention in the rebalance layer, which plausibly overstates rebalance cost ~3x. Under the alternative (funding-neutral) reading the stressed blended SR is ~5.9. Treat stressed carry as the RANGE [3.75, ~5.9]; 3.75 is the gate-relevant lower/stress bound and the gate passes at that bound.

Haircut fragility: the haircut curve (regime.json) crosses zero SR once realized funding capture falls below ~60-70% of the modeled series (h=1.00 SR 3.75, h=0.75 SR 2.04, h=0.50 SR -0.13, h=0.25 SR -2.73). The GO verdict is conditional on capturing at least ~65% of modeled funding income live; slippage on funding realization (missed events, exchange throttling, adverse rebalance timing) is the dominant risk to the edge.

2022 negative year: per-year SR 2022 = -2.03 (365 days), the single losing year, driven by sustained negative-funding stretches in the bear market (ETH 2022-Q2 neg-funding-day share 42.9%, BTC 26.4%). The sleeve is not funding-regime-agnostic.

Single 3.4-year in-sample window: all statistics are computed on one contiguous 2021-11-08..2025-03-31 window with no out-of-sample holdout. Per-year SR and worst-90d are descriptive of this window, not forward estimates.

In-sample worst-90d: the -1.82% worst-90d floor is the realized minimum over the same window used to accept the gate; a forward worst-90d could exceed it. Longest observed drawdown ~667 days (22 months, peak 2022-01-05 to recovery 2023-11-02) shows the sleeve can bleed for extended low-funding regimes even while passing the 90-day loss gate.
provenance_note: All gate inputs read directly from committed pass outputs (timing.json, costs.json, funding_recon.json, regime.json). No parameters were re-run or re-tuned to change the gate result.
